notes.title: Version 1.1 is available now!
notes.notes:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35324319/bedcdcc5fc43603c8eda65ad6759450b8403e358.jpg
Today we released a big update for the game. In addition to fixing small bugs, a new control system was added, now you can completely control the character with mouse (without using a keyboard or gamepad), the ability to increase the speed of the player, move the camera around the scene, more tutorials in each chapter. Some levels from the first and third chapters were removed, which seemed very long to many players, and leaderboards (spies and informants) were added.

Important: Now the update is available only for PC, within 1-2 days the version for Mac will be downloaded, and the updated demo version of the game.
